comment:
Thanks for the report.

The behaviour described here seems to come from Chromium or Node.js rather than Electron's own code, so it probably needs to be fixed upstream first. Linking an upstream bug here, if there is one, helps.

To look into this, a maintainer needs a way to reproduce it. Could you make a minimal example in [Electron Fiddle](https://www.electronjs.org/fiddle), save it as a gist and add the link here?

<sub>Automated first-pass triage. It can only add labels and comment; a maintainer makes every decision, including whether this issue stays open.</sub>

triage: kinds=upstream,need-repro refs=
interpretation: Scorer fields represent proposed actions, not GitHub writes.
explanation: Chromium connection allowlist behavior also reproduces in Chrome; the bug has only a one-line call and no runnable repro link, and no candidate reports the same behavior.
